## Strict functions converter

```go.mod
module github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/numeric

go 1.25
```

```go
// file: code.go
//go:generate go run github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/cmd/generator

package numeric

type TargetEnum int

type SourceEnum int

func fromTargetEnum(in TargetEnum) SourceEnum {
	return SourceEnum(0)
}

type Target struct {
	Field int
	Status TargetEnum
}

type Source struct {
	Field int32
	Status SourceEnum
}
```

```pkl
converter {
	functions {
		"github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/numeric.fromTargetEnum"
	}
}
packages {
	["github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/numeric"] {
		mode = "functions"
		source_pkg = "{CurrentPackage}"

		structs {
			["Target"] { source_struct_name = "Source" }
		}
	}
}
```

Expected generated source code is:

```go
// golden-file: gen_mapper.go
// Code generated by github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen - test, DO NOT EDIT.

package numeric

// ToTarget converts a Source value into a Target value.
func ToTarget(in Source) Target {
	var out Target

	out.Field = int(in.Field)
	out.Status = TargetEnum(in.Status)

	return out
}

// FromTarget converts a Target value into a Source value.
func FromTarget(in Target) Source {
	var out Source

	out.Field = int32(in.Field)
	out.Status = fromTargetEnum(in.Status)

	return out
}
```
